subject: This Week in Athens - January 20-26, 2025
text:
This Week in Athens
January 20-26, 2025

🎵 CONCERTS

Marina Satti Live
Date: Saturday, January 25, 2025
Time: 21:00
Venue: Gazarte
Price: From €20
The beloved Greek artist returns to Athens for an intimate acoustic set.

Jazz Night at Half Note
Date: Friday, January 24, 2025
Time: 22:30
Venue: Half Note Jazz Club
Price: €15
Featuring the Dimitris Kalantzis Quartet.

🎭 THEATER

The Glass Menagerie
Date: January 20-26, 2025 (Daily except Monday)
Time: 20:30
Venue: National Theatre of Greece
Price: €12-€25
Tennessee Williams' masterpiece in a new Greek production.

🖼️ EXHIBITIONS

Modern Greek Art
Date: Until March 15, 2025
Time: 10:00-18:00
Venue: National Museum of Contemporary Art (EMST)
Price: Free entry on Sundays
A retrospective of 20th century Greek artists.
